items.title: John Levy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: In fact, when we started to write my book and Devra looked up a lot of the discography of

ctx.x: But somehow you didn’t – in your book, you describe your play as not top-notch and not . . .

I wasn’t a great soloist. I wasn’t a great bass player in my estimation. I was better than a lot of them that were – that was there on 52nd Street when I got there, who had big names, and I couldn’t figure out why. I’m not going to name them for the world, but I was very disappointed, because I thought, hey, to work on 52nd Street, you had to really be something else, but these guys were popular because they were friends of somebody. It was the politics of the business, who they worked with. But I had all the…
That was the core of the group that Billie Holiday was – I noticed that . . .
